resumeText:
Kavya Iyer | Bengaluru | kavya.iyer@example.com

SUMMARY
AI engineering leader with 16 years in software, machine learning and GenAI products.

EXPERIENCE
Director of AI, Nilgiri Commerce, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Set the AI strategy and roadmap with the CEO and business heads.
- Run AI use case prioritisation each quarter and stop projects that miss value targets.
- Took architecture decisions on build or buy for models and vector stores.
- Shipped GenAI assistants for sellers and support using large language models.
- Set up model monitoring and MLflow for all production models.
- Wrote the AI governance policy with legal and risk teams.
- Grew the team from 12 to 45 through engineering hiring for ML and data roles.
- Managed a team of 6 managers across AI engineering and data science.
- Give quarterly board presentations on AI value, cost and risk.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with product and operations on adoption.

ML Engineering Manager, Konark Software, Pune (2016 - 2022)
- Led recommendation and search ML teams.

Software Engineer to Senior Engineer, various product companies (2010 - 2016)

EDUCATION
MTech Computer Science, IIT Madras, 2010
